segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Last weekend, my friend and I went to the mountains. We left home early on Saturday morning. First, we took a bus to the train station. The bus was late, so we waited for twenty minutes. After that, we took a train to a small town near the mountains. The train ride was about two hours. We arrived at the town at ten o'clock. Then we walked to a small hotel. We booked a room for one night. The room was clean but small. After that, we went to a restaurant for lunch. I had noodles and my friend had rice. The food was delicious. In the afternoon, we climbed a mountain. The weather was sunny and warm. We saw many beautiful flowers and a small river. We took a lot of photos. Finally, we went back to the hotel. We were very tired but happy. On Sunday morning, we had breakfast at the hotel. Then we took a train back home. We arrived home at six o'clock in the evening. It was a great trip. We want to go there again next year.
